hints.content: It takes one person $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of a minute to prepare one bag. There are $60$ seconds in a minute. That means it takes each person  $40$ seconds to prepare a bag, because $\dfrac{2}{3}\times 60=40$.

Since there are $5$ total people (Ashley and $4$ friends), they are filling $5$ bags per $40$ seconds. They need to fill $1575$ bags.

$1575\,\cancel{\text{bags}}\times \dfrac{40\text{ s}}{5\,\cancel{\text{bags}}}=12{,}600\text{ s}$

It will take them $12{,}600$ seconds to fill all of the bags. We want to know the number of *hours*.
It will take Ashley and her friends $3\dfrac{1}{2}$ hours to prepare the bags of samples.

question.content:
Ashley recently opened a store that uses only natural ingredients. She wants to advertise her products by distributing bags of samples in her neighborhood. It takes one person $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of a minute to prepare one bag. 

**How many hours will it take Ashley and $4$ of her friends to prepare $1575$ bags of samples?**

[[☃ numeric-input 1]] hours
